nom: OSEA Ocean Wave Cleanser Bi-Phase Cleansing Oil and Makeup Remover

avis.texte: Great cleanser that leaves the feeling of clean but also has an pil base that moisturizes. Vs other cleaners that make you feel more dry after
This product is just amazing on the skin! I've never had a toner that has left my skin feeling and looking just healthy and moisture. Wow!!

avis.titre: Love It, But It Doesn't Fully Remove Eyeliner
avis.texte: After about four months of using the Ocean Wave Cleanser, I'm pleased with the results overall. The only reason I'm not giving it a perfect review is that it doesn't completely remove my eyeliner. Other than that, it's been a great cleanser.

I received this as a sample and purchased a large bottle after one use. I'm now on my second bottle. If you double wash, you will not find a better first wash no matter what cleanser you use. It's also great to use alone. So luxurious and leaves skin more hydrated, plumped, calm, and glowing. Definitely a keeper! 47 and loving the healthy skin I'm in.

avis.titre: It does what other cleansers don't do!
avis.texte: I use a liquid eyeliner that is semi-permanent, and nearly impossible to get off. This gets cleans it away so well, and is incredibly gentle in doing so. It also, obviously, cleanses my whole face, and I love the way my skin feels after using it. I do tend to use it as part of a double cleanse, with the OSEA Ocean Cleanser. I highly recommend both, either separately or together.
The product has a grassy herbal but unpleasant scent. It's like washing your face with a dinner salad. No smell of lime or bergamot. Will return.
The Ocean Wave Cleanser is a game changer! I'm in the sun a lot gardening - and this cleanser moisturizes, soothes and is invigorating! I love! Want to share with friends!
Luscious and smooth. Treat yourself after sun. Softness lasts day and night. Makeup comes off completely.
I never want to be without this cleanser! It removes makeup and makes my face feel so good.
I use this before the Ocean Cleansing Milk, it's effective and soothing. It makes it easier to get makeup off and softens your skin. It's a wonderful addition to my skin care routine!

avis.titre: I cannot give enough compliments to this product or brand.
avis.texte: I absolutely love this Osea brand of face care products. Everything I have tried I have loved including this makeup remover/face cleansing oil. I have also tried the body oil and love it. I look forward to trying the body care line as well. Love it!!!
I had already washed my dash! Then I remembered this remover! Voila! I couldn't believe how much was left behind by my normal routine!
Love this! My face feels amazing after using it to remove all of my makeup, including all of my eye makeup. I have always had dry skin, and this cleanser is perfect in every way!

Another Osea product I'm obsessed with! I use it in the evening to take off my make-up. I use it with a cotton round and it takes off mascara, eye shadow, all of it! My skin feels supple and nourished when done!
Love this product. Gave some to my Mom who had run out of it and was using soap!! She was so happy to receive this. I like the gentle cleansing effect of this cleanser.

I've tried other organic cleansers that are advertised as non-drying. But as a 57-year-old post-menopausal woman, I've been finding it increasingly difficult to find cleansers that actually clean my face as well as keep it moisturized. I came back to the Osea's Ocean Wave Cleanser because it's the only one that does what I need. And my face is finally clearing up from all the dry, scaly patches that began to form around my cheeks and mouth area.
Especially for dry skin. I've been using it for about a month, and my skin is much brighter. Age spots have faded considerably, too. While I don't wear any makeup, I still love this cleanser.
This works great as a makeup remover but I wish it didnt leave my skin feeling so oily after.

I can't possibly understand why this would have such high reviews, surely some most be fake or incentivized. I've used many oil cleaners for 1st step in cleansing and this does NOTHING. Does not emulsify with water, very hard to rinse off. And makeup, still firmly on my face. Awful waste of money. I love the OSEA body oil, but this is a dud.
This cleanser is perfect for moderate to oily skin plus a little bit of dryness

avis.titre: Great for moisture and sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is great cleanser when you need a little extra moisture.
This is the stuff Mother Nature is made of! My face feels like its swimming under water in Hawaii!! I love love it! Just the candy my face had been craving!
The cleanser is effective at removing makeup, but it is too runny.
Gentle cleanser that mells amazing and is non greasy. Perfect for sensitive skin. OSEA you rock!
This product not only cleans well but the moisture it leaves behind is awesome. A lot of cleaners leave your face dry but not this one.

avis.titre: Wanted to Love It! But Just Can't...
avis.texte: I absolutely love Osea products and have gone through many, many bottles of the original Ocean Cleanser and cannot let it go. So I was really looking forward to the release of the Ocean Wave Oil Cleanser since I've used an oil cleanser nightly for years. Unfortunately, it was a total miss for me. It doesn't emulsify enough and it leaves an odd, filmy residue. I also broke out after using it a few nights so I am suspicious that this cleanser was the culprit considering I made no other changes to my skincare routine. Additionally, I didn't love the dispensing method. I would definitely prefer a pump but considering the water to oil ratio requiring a vigorous shake prior to use - perhaps a pump wouldn't work very well. Sadly, I did not find this cleanser effective or pleasant to use.
I love all the other products, but this one doesnt remove makeup and leaves my skin not feeling clean.
I love this product when Im at home using it but the travel supply leaks and is a waste of product. I travel for a living so this is a huge disappointment.

It's always so rude when you fall in love with a sample and its outside your budget! This stuff is a great moisturing cleanser. It's a solid makup remover, though it stings my eyes. It does require a thorough cleanse, otherwise I suspect it would cause breakouts. My skin is so soft! Wish I could justify the purchase.

avis.titre: Cleanser just isnt right for me
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product but sadly its just not the cleanser for me.

This is everything. I recently discovered my acne prone skin hates being washed with traditional facial cleansers. This is gentle, washes away all the makeup, and does NOT break me out. Thank you Osea.

This cleansing oil is fantastic! I received a sample of it and knew from the first use I had to have a full size bottle! It smells incredibly clean and feels so lovely on my skin. I have loved every product from Osea. I've also emptied several bottles! So wonderful! Thanks Osea!
Love the ocean cleanser and how it makes my skin feel great after using it!
This feels so clean and refreshing. I feel like Im doing something really nice for my skin when I use it.
So happy with the smell, texture, feel and cleansing properties
I do not use any make up because of my allergy. I gave this product to my friend and she is in love with it . States it is so much easy to remover her make up and her skin stay very nice

The first few days of using this product were great. However, on day 3 or 4 I noticed my skin felt more dry and tight after using this product and then started getting red and irritated. This is the first Osea product that hasn't been great for me.
Ill probably never use another cleanser again! Im a skin care product junkie and Im on my third bottle. I love this cleanser so much! It cleans off all of my makeup and leaves my skin so soft.
It makes you feel clean and smell fresh. And it lasts for hours. It also lasts for a long time.
I really wanted to like this but after cleansing my face with it, I use cotton swab and there was still makeup on the cotton ball. So it didnt cleanse my face the way I wanted it to.
Really love how my face feels after using this to remove my makeup.
I love getting samples. This was a great smelling and gentle body wash. Highly recommend!
Love it! Removes makeup and dirt amazingly well plus leaves my face feeling so soft after Im done washing.Highly recommend!

No facial cleanser has ever left my aging skin feel like this. I knew that Greek women cleansed their skin with olive oil but it felt way too goopy and thick for me. This is perfect. Couldnt be happier. My old skin is feeling revived.

avis.titre: Best thing i've ever put on my face
avis.texte: I put this oil on my face in the shower to wash o left it on for a minutes and rinsed it off in cold water after massaging in. After the shower my face looked 10x better then it did before and the pimple on my cheek was gone. My skin felt healthy and refreshed without feeling oily. Best cleansing oil!!!!
Definitely see a difference since using this product. The softness lasts throughout the day
I love Osea!!! The Osea cleanser is a gentle cleanser and really cleanses my face of makeup. And, as an added plus, the Ocean Wave Cleanser gives the face a refreshing feel and glow.

avis.titre: The BEST thing to combat dry skin
avis.texte: Ive tried many things in the winter months to keep my skin hydrated but this cleaner couple with the advanced atmosphere protection cream has been a game changer! Its light and even though it has moisturizing oils it doesnt leave your skin oily at all! Just cleans it really well! Takes off all the dirt or makeup my cleanser left behind. Then I put on the protection cream and my face has been so hydrated this winter! No more flaking or breakouts! I love this stuff!!!
This is the BEST make up remover Ive ever used. Try it! Thank you OSEA.

avis.titre: Good but you cant use the whole bottle.
avis.texte: The product is separated with half oil and half of some sort of lotion/cleanser. It needs to be shaken each time you pour it onto a cotton pad to stay mixed, which is ok. But about half way through the bottle, even though you shake it EVERY time, the oil portion of it is gone. Too bad because I like it when its the full mixed bottle. Otherwise, the other half of the jar has to be thrown away!
The body oil is terrific! Makes the skin very soft and shiny! Goes on extremely easy! Stays on for a the whole day!
Love this ocean wave cleanser, it took off my stubborn mascara and eyeliner! Would highly recommend if you wear heavy makeup and dont want to rub your skin off.

I've been using this product for roughly six months to remove my waterproof Lancôme mascara. The product burns my undereye, eyelid, and top of my cheekbones. I use a little as possible because it is effective at removing waterproof makeup, however it burns SO bad. It also leaves a filmy oil on the actual eyeball. I immediately have to do a water flush of my eye to get it to stop burning. I love their products, but this was an absolute miss.

I have been using this Cleanser nonstop, even in the days I dont use much makeup, it has a way to make me feel clean and hydrate at the same time. Tonight with my Halloween makeup was the true test, I was so impressed by the quick and efficient way that cleaned without needing to rub or strip my skin. I used this cleanser then in the shower I washed my face with Ocean cleanser. Its an amazing combination for heavy makeup. All other days I use one or the other. I love the scent of this cleanser, I love everything about it. Thank you OSEA for another 5 stars product.
Love this line of products but they missed the mark with this one.

avis.titre: Loved at first but will not be rebuying
avis.texte: Overall I did initially love this product but will not be repurchasing because I need to use SO MUCH product to get my make up off when used as a first cleanse. I typically only wear tinted spf and mascara and have to use 4+ cotton rounds to get my make up off. For the size of the product Id be going through about a bottle a month.

avis.titre: Wanted to love but not feeling it
avis.texte: I really wantef to love this as im constantly on a search for a cleanser, bit i felt like i had to yse so much in order to rub it in without pulling on my skin. If i use a lot of it, it seens to work well but i also have to wash my face several times to get the oily resudue off. Its more work thab its worth.

I have oily skin and found this product to be excellent for removing makeup, sunscreen, and cleansing. However, I can't tell if this product gives me a rash, and/or if this is also causing cystic acne on my chin? I'm going to give it a few more weeks of use to see if my skin is purging or if my skin just doesn't agree with this product. I'm also not the biggest fan of the packaging because it's tough to close the bottle with a hand full of oil.

I have had trouble with little whiteheads on my chin forever. Ive had facials and have tried everything out there. Once I started using this Ocean Wave cleanser my troubles were over. Within about two weeks my skin is so soft and not a sign of any whiteheads! Ive started to collect OSEA products and have thrown out everything else Ive ever used. Thank you for making such clean, effective products

This is one of the best things I use- I use it and clean off my make up and it feels clean enough after that, but then I use the face wash after too and my skin is just so clean. Easiest to get make up off that I've ever experienced. Love the smell, too.

I bought the travel size to use for a trip for the first time. Although it removed my makeup and sunscreen effectively, it was so hard to rinse off, and I was left feeling like an oil slick, even after rinsing multiple times. Even my hands felt oily. I'm left with no choice but to double cleanse with my regular gel cleanser. This is the same with the oil cleanser from Beekman. This does not happen with my regular oil cleanser from Origins, which I recommend.

This is my least favorite Osea product so far.. it does remove make up, but you have to use a lot of product and I really have to rub my eyes to get my (non-waterproof) mascara off, or it'll leave me with black eyes. While I do only use it as a pre-cleanse, it still leaves my face feeling oily. Also, the smell is gross. I'll be sticking to my dermalogica precleanse.

I am 63 years old ,this amazing product left my face like silk ,no heavy perfume smell or chemicals,natural and wonderful!Im so happy I took a chance and ordered this ,definitely will continue to use this .Did not have any redness which I usually get ,great for sensitive skin .

avis.titre: Clean, Gentle, Effective  OSEA Does It Again
avis.texte: As a long-time OSEA customer Ive trusted this brand with my skincare for years - and they continue to exceed my expectations. The Ocean Cleanser has been a staple in my routine for ages, but the new Ocean Wave Cleanser is truly something special. Its the perfect balance of refreshing, gentle, and effective - leaving my skin feeling clean, healthy, and never stripped. The texture is luxurious, and I love knowing that every ingredient is clean and thoughtfully selected. OSEA continues to prove that high-performance skincare doesnt have to come with harsh chemicals. The Ocean Wave Cleanser is a beautiful addition to my OSEA collection, and Im so impressed with how it enhances my routine. If youre already a fan of OSEA or looking to upgrade to skincare that truly delivers, this ones a must-try. Superior quality, beautiful results, and a brand I trust completely. Thank you, OSEA, for continuing to raise the bar!

I made the decision to try the Wave Cleanser and I am so glad I did. I am 58 years old, been using OSEA since 2017 and have tried other brands at less cost once/twice; always going back to OSEA. The Wave Cleanser leaves my skin soft and moisturized throughout the day (I do apply the advanced protection cream +night or hyaluronic serums after washing). Also, this formula seems to take off the makeup better than the milk cleanser. I wear a lot of 24hr matte lipsticks and can remove each night without scrubbing my face. I am sold on this OSEA product!

I first ordered this cleanser 4 months ago and really wanted to see the effects before I wrote a review. I must say, this product does not disappoint. The way my skin looks and feels is one of a kind! I noticed my skin is brighter, softer and feels amazing! I pair with the ocean cleanser and find that cleansing morning and evening has really taken my skin to another level!!
Living in the west, can very much dry skin. Excellent moisture wash.
I received a sample and tried this product. Its a wonderful face cleanser and I am sold on it. Its light with a lovely aroma, and my skin feels soft and clean. Perfect!
I really like this cleanser. It's light but does a thorough job, even through makeup and sunscreen. I will be reordering this one for sure!
This works really well at removing stubborn makeup. It leaves my skin soft and clean. I use it to double cleanse its perfect.
I love the scent, the lightness and the way it really really cleans my face! I will be buying this once my mini is gone. I have sensitive skin and this is the absolute best cleanser for it.

I got a travel set of OSEA items last year and it was no time at all before I bought myself more. My skin is always moist and glows. I'm 73 years old and after just a few months none of it on my arms is crepey nor saggy any more. My neck and chest are clear and have a beautiful sheen. I will continue to buy these products and try new ones as they come out. It truly is clean and safe, without chemicals or fake ingredients. Get a travel kit and give it a try!

Love this its so light and leaves my skin so soft I shared this with my sister in law her face was peeling so bad she used the oil cleanser it was amazing how it gently took all the dead skin off and left her face soft
I love all Osea products. The Body Balm is my favorite lotion in the world and must have and Ocean Cleanser I LOVE IT! This new one not so sure maybe Im not using it correctly
Really weird cleanser that seems to not even really clean. Unharmonious and awkward. Does not lather nor really spread easily on face.
I double wash so this is great I love that it has an oil you mix with the makeup remover. Leaves skin super soft and squeaky clean
1st Osea product that I cant use, irritated my face to the point of discomfort for DAYS.

I've been wanted to try an oil cleanser for years but am very loyal to Osea so I've stuck with the Ocean Cleansing Milk. I have such sensitive skin and it's so gentle and leaves my skin super soft. I pair it with the hyalauronic sea serum and the day glow oil:) I love it!!
A wonderful body wash that cleans beautifully and smells great
Love this product! It's the first I've tried of any type of oil cleanser. And it leaves the skin soooo soft

I just tilt the bottle to mix the oils up and then add the mixture to my fingers, and lightly apply the formula to my face. The feeling is one of luxuriousness. My face feels so smooth and clean afterward. Not only is this cleanser good for removing makeup, I use Ocean Wave Cleanser as a cleanser on its own.
I use this at night to take off the make up. Its smells nice leaves my skin clean and soft.
Love this..shake it and pour a bit into palms , rub all over face, the. I use a nice cotton ball all over. Amazing feel....all your products that I have purchased are sensational !

I've always loved oil cleansers and this one is truly remarkable, especially for mature skin. This product cleanses without stripping the skin. Smells wonderful and leaves you feeling clean, soft and refreshed.
I have very sensitive skin and this worked WONDERS, loving it!
I think this is my new favorite product! I had no idea an oil cleanser would be so effective and leave my skin so soft!

This oil cleanser goes on more watery than other oil cleansers Ive used, but feels great to massage it into my skin. Works wonderfully to clean my skin and keep it hydrated throughout the day. I love the scent, too. Smells natural.
A great cleanser. It is gentle and leaves my skin looking and feeling smooth.

I use a different oil cleanser and it works well to remove make up but doesnt make me break out. It feels like nothing. I dont like this one as much. It stings where I have peeling skin or breakouts. And it doesnt wipe off makeup easily like my other cleansing oil. This is a rare miss for Osea for me.

avis.titre: Fantastic! Gets tough makeup off quickly
avis.texte: I love this because it removed my waterproof and smudge proof makeup quickly. It just dissolves without needing to scrub or rub hard. I use it without water on a dry face, and then add water as I massage. I feel so soft and clean after. Typically follow with a cleanser.
I really love this cleanser. I have fair skin and it removes my eye makeup so easily and gently. I don't miss the stinging remover I used previously. Ocean Wave Cleanser has become my go to product.
Love the feel, how it cleans, how it leaves my skin feeling. Living in a dry climate and having mature skin, its a great product. I would give it a 5+ if it came with a flip top!!!

I have combo skin and I felt that it left a film on my face. Even after a double cleanse with a different cleanser. I love all thier other products but this one in particular just didnt mesh with my skin. Maybe with someone with dry skin is a better candidate.

avis.titre: Great brand, totally missed the mark with this product sadly
avis.texte: I hate leaving a bad review as I really respect the mission and quality ingredients of this brand but at the very premium pricepoint this new launch is utterly disappointing and the worst Cleansing Oil I have ever tried. It shouldn't even be called a cleansing oil because it is a straight oil blend and nothing more. I have tried dozens upon dozens of Cleansing Oils over the years between Kbeauty and mainstream brands and to date Caudalie's is my die hard staple. I use them for eye makeup remover since my teens as nothing is more gentle and way less messy than cleansing balm jars. Where that oil differs is among great ingredients it effortlessly in one pump removes my heavy eye makeup aka very rich black liquid liner and mascara. No smearing, turns milky with water, washes off clean and as I dont wear waterproof spf or foundation I only use on my face a few times a month for a deep clean of pores. I have combo very congestion/blemish prone skin and as anyone similar knows. oil anything no matter the claim of non pore clogging can be your enemy why I can never moiaturize with it nor use thick cleansing oils that leave a film or residue behind which is why most always have to follow with a cleanser unless you have super dry and not remotely breakout prone skin which isn't many people. I love the regular Gel Wash of this line being of the only gel cream hybrids on the market compared to gel or cream cleansers and leaves skin so soft hydrated snd lush while still managing to deep
I absolutely LOVE this new cleanser for my first cleansing!! It feels amazing and I can tell a huge improvement in my skin!
My face is kissed every time I use the Ocean Wave Cleanser my skin looks hydrated and feels soft I love the smell and I dont feel the need to use anything else afterwards.
Calms and skins, literally makes my adult acne face clear and vibrant! Thank you!!
